node.title: The mca_safe assembly implication, priced: constants and conventions uniform over the family
node.statement: The implicit lemma 'counting_frame + fm1 + strip + paid_closure + r2 + ext_lift => mca_safe' holds UNIFORMLY over the admissible family: (i) every exponent (B <= 3, B_F, budget arithmetic) is an absolute constant, not n-drifting; (ii) the stratified sum + first-match dedup compose with endpoint conventions printed once (descriptor-generated); (iii) the composition survives k up to 2^40 scales symbolically (wp3_2). The last unpriced composite implication of the adjacency/payment-completeness class.
node.attack_surface: mostly bookkeeping made explicit: a one-note assembly proof template with a constants ledger; the genuine content is the uniformity audit of each input's constant
node.falsifier: any input theorem whose constant is discovered to drift with n (would localize immediately in the constants ledger)
